source: GMI MCP get_model, recorded 2026-10-31. Long enum lists trimmed. No organisation data.

hy-image-v3.5-preview.description: Hy-Image-3.5-Preview is Tencent Hunyuan's image generation model, supporting text-to-image and reference-guided generation.

parameters.description: Text prompt describing the image to create, or the edit to apply to the reference images.
parameters.name: prompt

parameters.description: Optional reference image URLs (up to 5). Each must be under 20MB and reachable without authentication. Reference images do not affect price.
parameters.name: image

parameters.description: Exact output dimensions. Leave on Auto to let the model choose a size from the prompt and the pixel budget. Sizes above 2K (over 4,194,304 pixels) are billed at the higher $0.032 rate.
parameters.name: size

parameters.description: Pixel budget used when no Output Size is set. This is capped at 2k, so pick a higher size in size to go higher. Price is the same across all three tiers.
parameters.name: generate_max_pixels

parameters.description: Generation seed. Leave at 0 for a random seed; reuse a seed with the same prompt and size to reproduce a result.
parameters.name: seed

seedream-5.0-pro.description: Byteplus's next generation image generation model, handling text, single image, and multi image inputs.

parameters.description: Text prompt for image generation (recommended < 600 words).
parameters.name: prompt

parameters.description: Reference image URL or an array of URLs (jpeg/png). Up to 14 images are supported.
parameters.name: image

parameters.description: Method 1: '2K', '3K'. Method 2: 'WxH' (Total pixels: up to 4.19M; Aspect Ratio: 1/16 to 16).
parameters.name: size

parameters.description: Generate a sequence of related images automatically.
parameters.name: sequential_image_generation

parameters.description: Total(reference+generated) ≤ 15.
parameters.name: max_images

parameters.description: Specifies the file format of the generated image.
parameters.name: output_format

parameters.description: Whether to include an watermark saying AI Generated in the bottom right corner.
parameters.name: watermark

gpt-image-2.5-flare-generate.description: GPT Image 2.5 Flare generates high-quality images from text prompts, with five quality tiers and transparent-background support.

parameters.description: Text description of the image to generate.
parameters.name: prompt

parameters.description: Output resolution. Accepts "auto", the presets 1024x1024 / 1024x1536 / 1536x1024, or a custom WxH where both dimensions are multiples of 16, each edge <= 3840px, aspect ratio <= 3:1, and total pixels between 655,360 and 8,294,400.
parameters.name: size

parameters.description: Image quality level — affects detail and cost. GPT Image 2.5 supports five tiers plus auto.
parameters.name: quality

parameters.description: Number of images to generate (1-10).
parameters.name: n

parameters.description: File format of the generated image.
parameters.name: output_format

parameters.description: Compression level 0-100. Only valid for jpeg and webp output.
parameters.name: output_compression

parameters.description: Background handling. "transparent" produces an alpha channel and requires png or webp output.
parameters.name: background

parameters.description: Content moderation strictness.
parameters.name: moderation

parameters.description: Optional stable identifier for your end user, forwarded to OpenAI for abuse monitoring.
parameters.name: user

kling-3.0-turbo-t2v.description: Kling AI's 3.0 text to video model.

parameters.description: Describe the motion and action (up to 2500 chars). Refer to https://app.klingai.com/global/quickstart/klingai-video-3-model-user-guide for more detail
parameters.name: prompt

parameters.description: Choose between 720p or 1080p
parameters.name: resolution

parameters.description: Choose the video's aspect ratio
parameters.name: aspect_ratio

parameters.description: Total duration in seconds (3-15).
parameters.name: duration

wan3.0-video.description: Wan3.0 unified video model. One model for text-to-video, image-to-video, reference-to-video and video editing, with up to 30s duration, 480P-1080P output, adaptive aspect ratio and audio generated by default.

parameters.description:
- The prompt describes the desired elements and visual features in the generated video.

- Chinese and English are supported. Each Chinese character or letter counts as one character. Text exceeding the limit is automatically truncated.
parameters.name: prompt

parameters.description:
- Describes content you do not want to appear in the video.

- Chinese and English are supported. Limited to 500 characters; excess is truncated.

- Example: low resolution, error, worst quality, deformed, extra fingers, bad proportions.
parameters.name: negative_prompt

parameters.description:
Image used as the first frame of the generated video (image-to-video).

- Must be a publicly reachable HTTP(S) URL.

- Pair with `ratio: adaptive` to keep the source framing instead of forcing 16:9.
parameters.name: first_frame

parameters.description: Image used as the last frame of the generated video. Combine with `first_frame` to interpolate between two stills.
parameters.name: last_frame

parameters.description:
Reference image(s) used to keep a subject, character or style consistent across the generated video.

- Accepts a single URL or an array of URLs.

- Up to 10 images.
parameters.name: reference_image

parameters.description:
Reference video(s) used to guide motion or style.

- Accepts a single URL or an array of URLs.

- Up to 5 videos.
parameters.name: reference_video

parameters.description:
The model will use this audio to drive the generated video.

- Format: wav/mp3

- If the audio is longer than the video duration, only the first N seconds are used.
parameters.name: audio_url

parameters.description:
Specifies the resolution tier for the generated video. Affects pricing.

- **Case-sensitive**: send `480P`, `720P` or `1080P`. A lowercase value such as `720p` is rejected by the model and the request fails (and is refunded) instead of falling back.
parameters.name: resolution

parameters.description:
Specifies the aspect ratio of the generated video.

- `adaptive` derives the framing from the input media, and behaves the same as `16:9` when there is no media input. It is the recommended default for this model because a single model serves text-to-video and image-to-video.
parameters.name: ratio

parameters.description:
The duration of the generated video, in seconds. Affects pricing linearly.

- Wan 3.0 supports a single generation of up to 30 seconds.

- Note: 30 seconds at 1080P costs $6.00.
parameters.name: duration

parameters.description: Specifies whether to enable prompt rewriting. If enabled, a large language model (LLM) rewrites the input prompt to improve generation quality for shorter prompts, at the cost of slightly longer generation time.
parameters.name: prompt_extend

parameters.description: Specifies whether to add a watermark. The watermark contains the fixed text `AI Generated` and is placed in the lower-right corner of the video.
parameters.name: watermark

parameters.description:
- The random number seed in the range [0, 2147483647].

- If not specified, the system automatically generates a random seed.

- Note: because model generation is probabilistic, using the same seed does not guarantee identical results every time.
parameters.name: seed

happyhorse-1.1-i2v.description: HappyHorse 1.1 image to video (first frame). Animate any image into a video with strong motion coherence, improved facial texture fidelity, and native audio-video synchronization.

parameters.description:
- The prompt describes the desired motion and visual features in the generated video.

- Chinese and English are supported. Each Chinese character or letter counts as one character. Text exceeding the limit is automatically truncated.
parameters.name: prompt

parameters.description:
- Starting frame image for Image-to-Video generation.

- Image resolution: width and height must be between 360 and 2,000 pixels.

- File size: no more than 10 MB.
parameters.name: first_frame

parameters.description: Describes content you do not want to appear in the video. Chinese and English are supported. Limited to 500 characters.
parameters.name: negative_prompt

parameters.description: Specifies the resolution tier for the generated video. The aspect ratio is kept as consistent as possible with the input image. Affects pricing.
parameters.name: resolution

parameters.description: The duration of the generated video, in seconds. Affects pricing.
parameters.name: duration

parameters.description: Specifies whether to enable prompt rewriting using an LLM. Improves generation quality for shorter prompts but increases processing time.
parameters.name: prompt_extend

parameters.description: Specifies whether to automatically add native audio to the generated video.
parameters.name: audio

parameters.description: Specifies whether to add a watermark. The watermark contains the fixed text `AI Generated` and is placed in the lower-right corner of the video.
parameters.name: watermark

parameters.description: The random number seed. The value must be in the range of [0, 2147483647]. If not specified, the system automatically generates a random seed.
parameters.name: seed

luma-ray-3-2-generate.description: Luma Ray 3.2 video generation: text-to-video, image-to-video, video extend, and chain-referenced interpolation via the Luma Agents API.

parameters.description: Text description of the video, 1-6000 characters.
parameters.name: prompt

parameters.description: Output aspect ratio: 9:16, 3:4, 1:1, 4:3, 16:9, or 21:9.
parameters.name: aspect_ratio

parameters.description: Output resolution: 540p, 720p, or 1080p. 540p not available with HDR.
parameters.name: resolution

parameters.description: Video length: 5s or 10s. 10s not supported with hdr, start_frame, or end_frame.
parameters.name: duration

parameters.description: HDR-encoded MP4. Requires HDR access and 720p/1080p; not supported with 10s, loop, or extend.
parameters.name: hdr

parameters.description: Export an EXR alongside the MP4. Requires hdr=true; not supported on extend.
parameters.name: exr_export

parameters.description: Seamless loop. Not supported with 10s, hdr, or end_frame; forward-extend only.
parameters.name: loop

parameters.description: Start anchor frame for image-to-video. Not supported with 10s.
parameters.name: start_frame_url

parameters.description: End anchor frame for image-to-video or interpolation. Not supported with 10s.
parameters.name: end_frame_url

parameters.description: Chain-reference a prior generation as the start. Alone = forward extend; with end_frame = interpolation. Must be a completed video under the same API key.
parameters.name: start_frame_generation_id

parameters.description: Chain-reference a prior generation as the end. Alone = backward extend; with start_frame = interpolation. Must be a completed video under the same API key.
parameters.name: end_frame_generation_id

minimax-tts-speech-2.8-hd.description: Latest HD model with real-time response, intelligent parsing.

parameters.description: Text content to be converted to speech.
parameters.name: text

parameters.description: Voice ID for speech synthesis.
parameters.name: voice_id

parameters.description: Speech speed multiplier.
parameters.name: speed

parameters.description: Volume level multiplier.
parameters.name: vol

parameters.description: Pitch adjustment in semitones.
parameters.name: pitch

parameters.description: Emotion control for synthesized speech. By default, the model automatically selects the most natural emotion based on text. Manual specification is only recommended when explicitly needed.
parameters.name: emotion

parameters.description: Controls whether recognition for specific minority languages and dialects is enhanced. If the language type is unknown, set to 'auto' and the model will automatically detect it.
parameters.name: language_boost

parameters.description: Specifies the format of the generated audio. Default is mp3.
parameters.name: format

parameters.description: Specifies the sampling rate of the generated audio. Default is 32000 Hz.
parameters.name: audio_sample_rate

parameters.description: Specifies the bitrate of the generated audio. Default is 128000. Note: This parameter only applies to audio in mp3 format.
parameters.name: bitrate

parameters.description: Specifies the number of audio channels. 1 = mono, 2 = stereo. Default is 2 (stereo).
parameters.name: channel

parameters.description: Voice modification pitch adjustment. Adjusts the pitch of the synthesized voice for voice-changing effects. Range: -100 (lower) to 100 (higher).
parameters.name: vm_pitch

parameters.description: Voice intensity adjustment. Controls the strength/power of the voice. Range: -100 (weaker) to 100 (stronger).
parameters.name: intensity

parameters.description: Voice timbre adjustment. Modifies the tonal quality and character of the voice. Range: -100 to 100.
parameters.name: timbre

parameters.description: Applies special sound effects to the synthesized voice. These effects can create atmospheric or stylistic variations.
parameters.name: sound_effects

minimax-music-3.0.description: Generate AI music from lyrics and style prompts using Minimax Music 3.0 model.

parameters.description:
Song lyrics (1-3500 characters). Use '
' to separate lines. You can add structure tags like [Verse], [Chorus], [Bridge], [Intro], [Outro] to enhance arrangement.
parameters.name: lyrics

parameters.description: A description of the music style, mood, and scenario (0-2000 characters). For example: 'Pop, melancholic, perfect for a rainy night' or 'Upbeat electronic, energetic, dance club'.
parameters.name: prompt

parameters.description: Audio sample rate in Hz.
parameters.name: sample_rate

parameters.description: Audio bitrate in bps. Higher bitrate means better quality.
parameters.name: bitrate

parameters.description: Output audio format.
parameters.name: format

parameters.description: Auto-generate/enhance lyrics from the style prompt.
parameters.name: lyrics_optimizer
